cards.text: Present perfect dipakai untuk pengalaman dalam hidup sampai sekarang, sering dengan ever (pernah) dan never (tidak pernah).
Present perfect juga untuk periode yang masih berlangsung sampai sekarang: today, this week, this year, recently, so far, since ...

examples.en: I've drunk three cups of tea today.
examples.id: Hari ini saya sudah minum tiga cangkir teh.

examples.en: We haven't had any problems so far.
examples.id: Sejauh ini kami tidak mengalami masalah.

cards.text: Setelah It's the first time / the second time ..., pakai present perfect.

examples.en: It's the first time I've flown in a plane.
examples.id: Ini pertama kalinya saya naik pesawat.

cards.trap: Jangan pakai present simple: bukan It's the first time I fly.

questions.answer: Have you ever ridden a horse?
questions.why: Pengalaman dalam hidup: Have + you + ever + past participle (ridden).
Pengalaman hidup sampai sekarang memakai present perfect: have never + past participle.

questions.prompt: This is the first time I ___ sushi.
questions.why: Setelah This is the first time, pakai present perfect: have eaten.
ever (pernah) dipakai dalam pertanyaan tentang pengalaman, di antara have/has dan past participle.

questions.prompt: It's the second time I lose my phone this year.
questions.answer: It is the second time I have lost my phone this year.
questions.why: Setelah It's the second time, pakai present perfect.
Pengalaman sampai sekarang (berapa kali) memakai present perfect. Dewi = she, jadi has read.

accept: I have never met him before
I have never met her before
I have not met him before
I have not met her before
questions.why: Pengalaman hidup sampai sekarang memakai present perfect: have never met.

pairs: Have you ever been to Bali?
No, he hasn't called me for weeks.
How many cups of coffee have you had today?
What's the best film you've ever seen?
questions.why: Semua pertanyaan membahas periode sampai sekarang (ever, recently, today), jadi memakai present perfect.

questions.prompt: We ___ a lot of interesting people since we arrived.
questions.why: since we arrived = sejak tiba sampai sekarang, jadi present perfect.

questions.prompt: I haven't seen Tom this morning.
questions.answer: I haven't seen Tom this morning.
questions.why: Kalimat ini sudah benar jika sekarang masih pagi: periode this morning belum selesai, jadi present perfect.
